ov: فيرديناند (الإنجليزية: Ferdinand) هو فيلم دراما-كوميديا ومغامرة أنتج سنة 2017 من إخراج كارلوس سالدانا ومن إنتاج شركات استديوهات بلو سكاي، وتونتيث سينتشوري فوكس دافيس إنترتايمنت، ويعتبر هذا الفيلم من أعمال المصارع الشهير جون سينا والحكاية مؤلفة من القصة أو الرواية قصة فيرديناند (الإنجليزية: The Story of Ferdinand). ويعتبر أيضا من الفيلم السابق فيرديناند الثور (الإنجليزية: Ferdinand the Bull). وقصة الفيلم تشبه تقريبًا مصارعة الثيران ولكن لم يعرض لحظات المصارعة سوى في اللحظات الأخيرة.
plotEn:
In Spain, a calf named Ferdinand lives with other bulls at Señor Moreno's Casa del Toro, whose owner trained them for bullfighting. Ferdinand is a pacifist, which his peers, Valiente, Guapo, and Bones mock. The matador arrives, and the fathers fight to impress him, Ferdinand's father Raf is picked, so Valiente crushes Ferdinand's flower in retaliation. Raf does not come back from the ring, and Ferdinand runs away from Casa del Toro to a flower farm owned by Juan and his daughter Nina adopts him.
Years later, Ferdinand has grown into an enormous but still gentle bull. One day, Ferdinand looks too scary to take along to the annual flower festival in Ronda, as in previous years. Ferdinand follows them anyway, but is stung by a bee and panics, accidentally destroying the town square and wreaking havoc in a china shop. Animal control officers deem him dangerous, and take him away before Juan and Nina can explain.
The officers give him to Casa del Toro, where he reunites with Valiente, Bones, and Guapo, as well as Lupe, a female goat, and two new bulls, Angus and Maquina. Ferdinand tries to escape, but is stopped by three Lipizzan horses Klaus, Greta, and Hans.
The next day, snooty matador El Primero arrives, needing a bull for his final bullfight before retirement. Moreno puts all the bulls in a ring to fight it out, but Ferdinand refuses to take part, causing mishaps when he tries to help Guapo recover from a stage fright-induced faint.
